statement: AMD claims Helios delivers 30% more tokens per dollar than competing systems, with ROCm software gains of 3.3x inference and 2.4x training over ROCm 7.
why: If a challenger genuinely improves tokens per dollar, it pressures the incumbent's pricing and lowers the cost of serving inference across the market.

impact.mechanism: Better cost per token from a second vendor plus large software throughput gains reduces the effective price of inference capacity and pressures incumbent margins.

evidence.source: ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
evidence.excerpt: claimed to deliver "30% more tokens per dollar than competition."

evidence.source: ServeTheHome (AMD Advancing AI 2026 Keynote Live Coverage)
evidence.excerpt: ROCm software performance claims: "3.3x inference performance improvement over ROCm 7"; "2.4x training performance gains."

confidence.basis: Secondary coverage of vendor marketing claims with unspecified competitor baselines and no independent verification.

dispersion: Competitive claims cite unspecified baselines, including a separate "2x performance/agents per watt advantage over competitors" with no named comparator.
